calendar.window: League tip-off, Oct 20 to Oct 30, before the Cup opener at the Clippers. The Pelicans open at home against Indiana on Wednesday, Oct 21.
First confirmed home game after Oct 30, then confirmed Cup Friday home nights through Nov 27

calendar.basisNote: Black Friday is the day after Thanksgiving (fourth Thursday of November), Nov 27 in 2026; Christmas Eve is Dec 24
Twelfth Night is Jan 6, the start of Carnival; the Jan 26 end is the brief's own cutoff

calendar.window: Around Feb 6, Tết in New Orleans East
Feb 10 to early March: after Mardi Gras, through the trade deadline, All-Star and the LHSAA playoffs
Late February through Apr 16 (Lent, crawfish, any Play-In)
French Quarter Fest through the end of Jazz Fest (mid-April to early May)
White Linen Night, the first Saturday of August. Nothing commercial on Aug 29.
Labor Day weekend (Southern Decadence) into the first second-line Sundays
calendar.basisNote: Labor Day is the first Monday of September, Sep 6 in 2027, so the weekend runs Sep 4-6
calendar.actNote: Agree terms directly with this season's second-line club partner.
